# Lorem Ipsum Generator

> Free online lorem ipsum generator at https://loremmaker.com. Generates placeholder text by paragraph, sentence, word, or exact character count, with themed word banks (Corporate, Tech, Foodie, Cat, Funny) and a custom word bank. Output copies as plain text, HTML, or Markdown. Runs entirely in the browser, with no sign-up.

## Generators

- [Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://loremmaker.com/): the main tool with every option
- [Lorem Ipsum 500 Characters](https://loremmaker.com/lorem-ipsum-500-characters): exact character-count text for testing limits
- [Funny Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://loremmaker.com/funny-lorem-ipsum-generator): humorous English filler words instead of Latin
- [Lorem Ipsum 100 Words](https://loremmaker.com/lorem-ipsum-100-words): a short passage of exactly 100 words
- [Lorem Ipsum 500 Words](https://loremmaker.com/lorem-ipsum-500-words): long-form text for article layouts
- [Corporate Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://loremmaker.com/corporate-lorem-ipsum-generator): business-style placeholder text
- [Tech Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://loremmaker.com/tech-lorem-ipsum-generator): startup and developer placeholder text
